semanticInputRoles.name: pinned committed policy

dispatchTransport.digest: 64 lowercase hex SHA256 of canonical decoded bytes
dispatchTransport.strictBase64: no whitespace,canonical padding and re-encoding equality
dispatchTransport.rejectedOversize: before decode if predicted length exceeds template;no truncation;invalid inputs not admitted

request.grammar: exact ordered key=value LF,nonempty printable ASCII,no CR/NUL/unknown/duplicate/trailing fields
request.hashRoles: policy/collector/workflow raw-file SHA256 supplied by approved external request after publication;no self-referential commit/hash inside those files
request.externalRequestDigest: external ledger spends this whole request before dispatch;not checked against a self-written signature

policy.initialValues: Bound local successor:one exact host_pwsh OBSERVE_ONLY target,three UNUSED rows,ref/action/nonce/retention literals below;live path,host,commit,time and run facts remain unobserved. No invocation or publication authority.
policy.sourceStaticReference: accepted local v3 seal only;not delivered or invoked

authority.N1: SUPPLIED_ASSUMPTION:workflow namespace discipline,fresh windows-2025 x64 VM;trusted service/admin/SYSTEM,authorized dispatcher and reviewed setup;no adversarial same-account/admin/SYSTEM guarantee
authority.N2: SUPPLIED_ASSUMPTION:absolute host-versus-dispatcher UTC error<=30s throughout request;not measurement/SLA;subtract30s

externalLedger.duplicateRun: attempt1 alone does not prevent it;external ledger/actor discipline is trusted,not GitHub replay enforcement
externalLedger.mutationCapability: later dispatcher must expose exact run-details return;not implemented or invoked here

authority.scope: ACQUIRE only;existing M01/B0 lease/native consumers unchanged;no SID/ACL/volume/parent-job proof fields fabricated

copyAccounting.kind: named logical serialized-byte bound,not heap/native/CLR/OS process-memory proof
copyAccounting.actualGuard: source Prepare-Metadata recomputes actual input/context/path/A/I lengths plus complete transient/readback/hold reservations before claim;no future fact invented
copyAccounting.aliases: caller parameter is same managed string reference;OS-native and managed context/transport charged twice explicitly;no whole ASCII request/policy text or split-line copy;file row slices do not duplicate row strings
copyAccounting.canonicalBase64Temporary: <=3416 UTF16 bytes retires after pure equality before policy IO;not concurrent with complete metadata phase
copyAccounting.postIntentRetirement: decoded/policy raw/context wire/admission/intent/claim buffers retire only after complete write/flush/close/readback,with immutable archive bytes and hashes retained
copyAccounting.terminalPhase: maximum57148 named logical bytes including two10240 rows;not concurrent with retired A/I/raw buffers or result construction
copyAccounting.recordReadbacks: <=1024 chunks except terminal row<=10240;selected/source file raw hash chunks<=65536 are separate read/hash workspace,not copied full metadata
copyAccounting.unmeasured: CLR strings/array/dictionary/boxing/hash/file/task internals,GC/native/OS/provider copies and stack;not counted as observed zero

outputs.injectivity: fixed prefix/nonce width and delimited digit-only run/fixed job/attempt,source byte domains;no path separator/traversal/ADS/trailing dot-space
outputs.upload: literal allowlist six leaves plus sibling claim;closed success only,no wildcard/always recovery or reopen pending
outputs.admissionWire: 128-byte header:version/3 lengths,actual clock bracket/frequency/UTCticks/endpoints,nonce,N1/N2 marker;canonical request+policy+context exact bytes
outputs.intentWire: canonical actual SPENT plan/readset/namespace/request/policy/context hashes/clock mapping;no future freshness/completion fact
outputs.controlWire: bounded exact field records with provenance/status/extent/hash and actual available brackets;each append flush/readback-verified before dependent action;fixed-site summaries are explicit cuts
outputs.resultWire: <=1024 actual template within8192 ceiling;digest/range/status references full immutable records,not lost-fact reconstruction
outputs.terminalWire: 32x10240;16 LE header(index,state,length,flags)+10224 payload/padding;state1 documented text with explicit provenance,state2UNAVAILABLE_UNUSED;no full snapshot;readback byte equality/EOF
outputs.finalEndpoints: self/final publication timing unavailable on wire;only live known return supports completion;no recursive receipt fiction

time.origin: external monotonic observation BEFORE dispatch;queue/setup/checkout/delivery consume same UTC expiry
time.tailSeconds60: ceiling only;immediate freeze/park,no tail completion promise
time.jobTimeoutMinutes15: vendor job-execution domain;not enforcement of dispatch-to-expiry;may automatically terminate/lose evidence
time.externalObservation: only returned new run ID,<=15 status reads>=60s apart inside original window;not implemented here

failure: retain all arguments/objects/results first;late/failed/unknown freezes and parks without new IO/publication/close/retry;host loss unknown;no physical timeout/closure guarantee
